meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: NanoClaw 会增加 iMessage 频道支持。配置后，你可以通过 iMessage 给机器人发消息，机器人也能用 iMessage 回复。支持本地模式（在这台 Mac 上读消息库，需要完全磁盘访问权限）或远程模式（通过 Photon 服务器连接你自己的 iMessage 账户）。
howto.when: 当你说出“add imessage”“connect imessage”等关键词，或要求接入 iMessage 时触发，随后会询问使用本地还是远程模式。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 频道
say.note: 开始配置，会先问本地还是远程模式。

say.text: 用本地模式连我的 iMessage
say.note: 这台 Mac 需 macOS 并授予完全磁盘访问权限。

say.text: 连接 Photon 远程 iMessage
say.note: 需要提供 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API key。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw gains iMessage channel support. After setup you can message the bot from iMessage and it replies there. Modes: local (reads this Mac's chat.db, needs Full Disk Access) or remote (via a Photon server account).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "add imessage", "connect imessage", etc., or ask to integrate iMessage. Then it asks whether to use local or remote mode.

say_en.note: Prompts you to pick local or remote mode.

say_en.text: Connect my iMessage using local mode
say_en.note: Requires macOS and Full Disk Access for Node.

say_en.text: Set up remote iMessage via Photon
say_en.note: Asks for your Photon server URL and API key.
